info.title: registry.directory API
info.summary: Machine-readable surface of registry.directory, the discovery layer for the shadcn/ui registry ecosystem.
info.description:
registry.directory indexes shadcn/ui registries so an agent can find the right component across the whole ecosystem, and accepts new registry submissions with a single HTTP POST.

When to use this API: (1) discover which registries exist and where their registry.json lives (`GET /directory.json`); (2) search the cross-registry component index (`GET /items.json`); (3) read a component's metadata, dependencies, and full source as Markdown (`GET /api/markdown/{owner}/{repo}/{slug}`); (4) submit a registry to the directory on behalf of its author (`POST /api/submit`).

Submission is one unauthenticated POST — no account, no fork, no PR. The full human-readable contract, including prerequisites and the review process, is at https://registry.directory/how-to-submit.md. Installation of components is not this API's job: use the shadcn CLI against the origin registry once you know which registry has what you need.

get.summary: List every registry in the directory
get.description: The full directory: every indexed shadcn/ui registry with its homepage, registry.json URL, GitHub repo, optional shadcn namespace, and declared premium offerings. Static file, rebuilt when the catalog changes. Its canonical JSON Schema is published at https://registry.directory/schemas/directory.json.

A flattened index of every renderable item across all indexed registries: name, type, description, categories, and which registry it belongs to. Use it to answer "which registry has X?" without fetching each registry.json. Static file, rebuilt on deploy.

get.summary: A component as Markdown: metadata, dependencies, full source
get.description: Returns one registry item as a single Markdown document: title, description, metadata (type, registry, dependencies), and every file's full content in fenced code blocks. The item's source is fetched live from its origin registry. Alias: any item page URL with `.md` appended (`https://registry.directory/{owner}/{repo}/{slug}.md`) rewrites to this endpoint. For registries without a GitHub repo, the handle form `https://registry.directory/{handle}/{slug}.md` works the same way.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: GitHub owner of the registry (or the registry's handle for GitHub-less registries).

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: GitHub repository name of the registry.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The item's name as listed in the registry index (may contain slashes).

404.description: Unknown registry, unknown item, a category slug (categories have no Markdown view), or the origin registry did not resolve.

post.summary: Submit a registry to the directory
post.description: Submit a shadcn/ui registry for listing on registry.directory. One unauthenticated POST creates a pending submission; a maintainer audits it (the registry.json and several items are fetched and must resolve with real content) and a human makes the final call. The 201 response returns a `submission_token` exactly once — keep it: re-POSTing the same `registry_url` with that token as an `Authorization: Bearer` header updates the pending submission. Full contract and prerequisites: https://registry.directory/how-to-submit.md

201.description: Submission created and queued for review. `submission_token` is shown only in this response.

200.description: Pending submission updated (valid bearer token supplied).

400.description: Body is not valid JSON, or validation failed (`fields` maps each invalid field to its errors).

403.description: A pending submission exists for this registry_url and the bearer token is missing or wrong. The original submission stays intact.

409.description: This registry is already listed in the directory, or a pending submission exists and updates are not enabled. No action needed.

422.description: The `namespace` claim does not match the official shadcn registry index.

503.description: Submission storage not configured. Try again later.

submissionToken.description: Only needed to UPDATE a pending submission. The token is returned once, in the 201 response that created the submission. It never travels in the body.

DirectoryEntry.description: One registry in the directory. Canonical JSON Schema: https://registry.directory/schemas/directory.json

description.description: One sentence describing what the registry provides.

github_url.description: GitHub repository URL, when the registry has one.

registry_url.description: Direct URL to the registry's registry.json index.

IndexedItem.description: One component in the cross-registry index.

name.description: Item name as registered in its registry index.

type.description: shadcn registry item type, e.g. registry:ui, registry:block.

description.description: Item description; empty string when the registry declares none.

basePath.description: Path of the registry on registry.directory: /{owner}/{repo} or /{handle}. The item page is {basePath}/{name}.

ProOfferings.description: Premium offerings the registry sells. All five booleans are required when the object is present; omit the object entirely for a plain open-source registry.

figma_kit.description: Sells or bundles a Figma kit.

mcp_agent.description: Offers an MCP server or agent integration.

SubmissionRequest.description: A registry submission. The four required fields are enough for a plain open-source registry. Unknown fields are ignored.

description.description: One sentence describing what your registry provides.

url.description: Your registry's homepage. Must use https.

registry_url.description: Direct URL to your registry.json file (e.g. https://example.com/r/registry.json). This is the unique key for your submission. Must use https.

namespace.description: Your official shadcn registry handle (e.g. @acme). Only claim it if it is yours in the official shadcn registry index — it is verified.

featured.description: Up to 6 item names to showcase. Each must exist in your registry index. Omit instead of sending an empty array.

id.description: Stable submission id derived from registry_url.

submission_token.description: Only in the 201 response, and only once. Send it as an Authorization: Bearer header to update this submission later.

error.description: Human- and agent-readable explanation of what went wrong and what to do next.

docs.description: Where the relevant contract is documented.
